name: The open C
idea: The C of ChipIn is an open hand that receives a small square chip, so the first letter already says that the model goes in the chip.

name: The C spirals in
idea: One unbroken trace draws a C and keeps turning inward like an on-chip coil, so the first letter of the name literally goes in.

name: Into the square
idea: A wedge cut drives into a solid square, the simplest picture of something going in, and the wordmark repeats it by turning the light Chip into a heavy In.

name: CI from above
idea: The initials C and I lock together into the outline of a square die seen from above, so the monogram is both the name and the chip.
